topics.topic: Authority required to resume a draft-write element after service_unreachable
questions: When resuming an element waiting on `service_unreachable` for a `draft-write` node (which normally has no approval/grant), which authority must the resend use?
When resuming a draft-write element waiting on service_unreachable (not not_applied), is authority flow activation, or must approval/grant be present per A14 wording?

topics.topic: Deterministic precedence for reporting validation failures when multiple faults exist
questions: Inside the embedded A09/A02 port-shape validations, what exact first-failure precedence must be reported when multiple per-port faults coexist (for example placeholder-type fault and media-type fault)?
If multiple elements in the same `many` input fail schema/size checks, which one must be reported as the refusal cause?
For a `many` port where several list elements violate schema/size, what deterministic sub-order picks the named failure?

topics.topic: When and how required_headers validity must be re-validated for accepted bindings (accept-time vs pre-send, including failure detail)
questions: If a binding was accepted, then after restart the selected instance has invalid `required_headers` (e.g., duplicate names case-insensitively), which exact pre-send failure check/detail applies?
When accepting a proposed binding, must the kernel re-run only rule 6's manifest-record checks, or the full rule 5 list including instance-selection/api_base_url/required_headers checks?

topics.topic: Which HTTP headers are covered by request_digest/approval (explicit vs transport-added, including multipart boundary behavior)
questions: Which headers are included in request_digest when the HTTP stack adds transport headers (for example Host, Content-Length, User-Agent, Connection), and are those implicit headers allowed to change approval validity?
Does "every header the kernel sends" include transport/library-added on-wire headers (e.g., Host, Content-Length, User-Agent), or only headers explicitly set by kernel logic?
How is approval stability guaranteed for multipart requests if Content-Type includes a boundary value that may change per send?

topics.topic: Crash-recovery handling of in-flight attempts and associated approval transition/order of persistence calls
questions: On restart recovery of an in_flight attempt, must the linked approval always be transitioned to used, and in which store call/order relative to writing outcome_unknown NodeExecution?

topics.topic: Exact JSON equality semantics for guard value comparison
questions: What exact equality algorithm is used for comparing JSON guard values (notably numeric forms like 1 vs 1.0, object key order, and string normalization)?

topics.topic: How size limits apply to `many` ports in trial cases (per item, whole list, or both)
questions: For a `many` value or `many` file port in a trial case, is size enforced per element, per whole list payload, or both?

topics.topic: Required shape of run response before terminal state (include all outputs with reasons vs only produced outputs)
questions: For a run that is still `running`/`awaiting_approval`/`pending`, must the response include every flow output with reason codes, or only produced outputs?
